bio: Died 1754 aged about 96. Justice of the peace and sheriff; member of the NY Assembly 1693–98; commissioner to lay out the King's Highway from Brooklyn to East Hampton (Akerly 1898). Married Mehitable Wells, daughter of William Wells by his second wife Mary — since Wells's first wife was Bridget, widow of Henry Tuthill (John Jr.'s grandmother), the couple were not blood relatives. Children (Akerly) include James (of Brookhaven and Orange Co.), Mary (1687–1780, m. Jonathan Horton; mother of Rev. Azariah Horton), Freegift (1698–1765), Joshua (m. Hannah Reeve) and John III of Southold (will 1740). Cousins through him and Mehitable: Rev. Azariah Horton (1C9R), Rev. Theodore L. Cuyler (5C5R).
